title: Hybrid Fire Drive v1
status: Playable geographic driving foundation; Gaussian registration unverified

reused.handling: Source gameplay-systems.js pumper envelope and acceleration/braking constants, adapted into a new fixed-step kinematic controller
reused.contact: Four source-terrain wheel samples; independently tested oriented footprint collision and swept motion

vehicle.cors: Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * verified on 2026-10-21; browser success also tested
vehicle.fallback: Bounded 9-second fetch, SHA-256 verification; procedural vehicle if unavailable. ?vehicle=fallback explicitly exercises fallback.

layers.collision: Mapped terrain triangles, estimated road corridor widths and source building footprints. Gaussian opacity/visibility never changes collision.
layers.visual: Three.js r180 opaque mesh world plus optional existing Spark 2.3.1 Gaussian layer, same depth buffer. No retraining or source/model overwrite.
layers.coordinates: Map X east, Z south, Y up, local metres. Original model basis is preserved, then upright uniform scale + yaw + XYZ translation. No nonuniform stretching.

registration.controls: Identifiable ground points only; >=3 fit and >=2 independent checks, spatial spread/area and residual gates. Passing residuals do not verify landmark identity or surveyed accuracy.
registration.persistence: Local browser storage bound to selected model ID and SHA-256; JSON import/export. Never changes map geometry.

licenses.component: Adapted Map Game and new simulator code

limitations: This is a playable test foundation, not a finished AAA game or certified driver-training simulator.
All 284 building heights, roof/facade detail and road widths are estimates. No surveyed geographic accuracy claim.
Current source Gaussian geometry remains blurry/streaked and does not align reliably to mapped facades. A mesh does not repair the captured model.
Current route is an open half-block capture; a complete photographic block is not claimed.
Kinematic truck handling: no tire forces, suspension solver, damage, traffic AI, pedestrians, firefighting missions, cab interior, weather or multiplayer.
Browser phone layout is emulated; physical phone/gamepad behaviour and performance are not certified.
Detailed pumper needs the pinned public GitHub asset; map and procedural vehicle remain playable without that external asset. Other local site data is still required.
Raw source footage and private machine paths are not published. Existing demos and production Map Game are preserved.
